requests.prompt: Native 32x32 Barrowfield-to-dirt Wang tileset for the adventure-map showcase. The literal material, transition, scale, camera and style requirements are in parameters.

parameters.lower_description: quiet ordinary warm brown dirt with compact irregular grains, uniform illumination and no road, border, object, repeated row, gradient or tile extrusion. Authentic hand-placed 1990s warm storybook strategy-game pixel art, crisp selective outlines, compact painterly clusters, consistent upper-left light, readable at native resolution, mundane first read, never grimdark.
parameters.upper_description: quiet pale country grass with chalky straw and subtle well-tended hummock texture. Every cell represents roughly one human-sized patch of ground. Incidental insects, fungi, bone chips or paint flecks must stay 1–5 pixels; a branch, ridge or crack may span 8–14 pixels but must remain flat. Authentic hand-placed 1990s warm storybook strategy-game pixel art, crisp selective outlines, compact painterly clusters, consistent upper-left light, readable at native resolution, mundane first read, never grimdark. Quiet continuous opaque field, uniform edge values, no focal object, border, path, gradient, checkerboard, text or watermark.
parameters.transition_description: a narrow pale-grass-to-dirt edge with sparse chalky root pixels; two or more alternate irregular edge profiles, restrained pixel-scale feathering, no cliff, wall, glow, outline band or oversized motif.
